**APIV1Service.SignIn — server/router/api/v1/auth_service.go**

The business-logic handler is `func (s *APIV1Service) SignIn(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.SignInRequest) (*v1pb.SignInResponse, error)` at `server/router/api/v1/auth_service.go:51`. It handles both password-based authentication (bcrypt comparison against the stored hash) and SSO (OAuth2) sign-in, then issues an access token via `doSignIn`.

Note there is also a thin Connect-RPC wrapper, `ConnectServiceHandler.SignIn` in `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go:78`, but it just delegates to `APIV1Service.SignIn`, which is where the RPC is actually handled.
